coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and measurement of per-task accuracy differences. The latter omits the specified improvement target.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 21 rather than 23 BBH tasks. Does not implement PaLM 2-L-IT as optimizer with text-bison as scorer, the 20% optimization/80% testing split, or optimization starting from an empty instruction; instead, it evaluates published instructions. It measures evaluation accuracy rather than final training accuracy and omits the target of >5% improvement on at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
